baseline: Existing app and clean synthetic account/data using documented UI; public service must not be modified for scoring.
live_pubmed: Real official PubMed service reachable; use known real publication metadata and abstracts, not mocked responses.
evidence_fixture: An isolated already saved answer and associated source snapshots; may be created using existing documented workflow/fixture loader before CUA.
history_fixture: At least two synthetic owned conversations with known titles/turns and a second owner where required.
saved_fixture: Synthetic bookmarks, collections and saved searches prepared in isolated evaluation account/database.
working_provider: Authorized working model provider with bounded approved usage and real generation/review; no spending without separate permission.
unconfigured_mode: Independent evaluation instance with deliberately absent AI provider configuration; real PubMed may still require access.
configured_unchecked: Isolated instance with server-side provider settings but no successful connection probe yet.
controlled_provider_failure: Authorized documented test-only provider failure (timeout/invalid endpoint/failed generation), not production application code modification.
accepted_answer_fixture: A real previously accepted model-generated answer with saved evidence/review state; no canned success substituted for live generation test.
latency_fixture: Documented test-safe controllable delayed retrieval/generation/save flow in disposable environment; no frontend rewriting.
hosted_public: Use the verified public HTTPS demo with only disposable synthetic accounts and no service mutation outside normal UI.
upstream_fault: Isolated, documented test-safe upstream PubMed failure or throttle fixture; never count it as actual live PubMed success.
untrusted_source_fixture: Synthetic malicious-looking publication data in isolated fixture; never real patient data and no live exploit payload.
overlap_fixture: Two controlled retrieved query-result sets sharing a real/synthetic PMID, with traceable provenance.
wrong_language_fixture: Controlled model fixture delivering specified wrong-language response twice; never count as actual live-model generation.
claim_reject_fixture: Documented controlled provider/reviewer rejection with an intact real/synthetic source snapshot.
missing_metadata_fixture: Known PubMed publication or controlled fixture with one truly unavailable metadata field.
multi_query_fixture: Stored result with more than one executed query and separate per-query PMID evidence lists.
long_abstract_fixture: Long real/synthetic abstract available in isolated test account; original-source text remains auditable.
quota_fixture: Explicit approved test-safe simulated 429 / provider allowance exhaustion without incurring charges.
glossary_fixture: One known supported and one known unsupported term identified from documented glossary, not guessed from UI behavior.
missing_abstract_fixture: Known PubMed record or controlled publication fixture genuinely lacking an abstract.
snapshot_update_fixture: Two versions of publication metadata in an isolated documented fixture to verify immutability of answer-specific snapshots.
global_quota_fixture: Test-safe globally shared provider allowance fixture across two synthetic accounts.
unsupported_citation_fixture: Controlled AI draft with a citation PMID/DOI not in the persisted evidence snapshot.
altered_quote_fixture: Controlled AI draft containing an altered/misattributed excerpt with a real saved source.
unsupported_number_fixture: Controlled AI draft claiming an unsupported number despite a valid saved citation.
persistence_fault: Test-safe isolated save failure/recovery fixture; do not modify product behavior.
hosted_docs: Current linked repository/deployment documentation visible in Chrome; documentation is external evidence, not proof of hosting internals.
hosted_optional: An explicitly labeled shared synthetic demo account is configured and documented, if such an option is published.
ime_environment: Actual Chrome with Chinese IME available for genuine composition-input testing.
date_fixture: PubMed record with separately documented electronic/issue dates.
zero_result_fixture: Known zero-result PubMed query in isolated environment with explicit source response.
no_limitations_fixture: Source-backed answer where no limitations are extracted/supported, not a fabricated medical conclusion.
evidence_gap_fixture: Research outcome with explicitly supported evidence-gap statement for inspection.
numeric_answer_fixture: Accepted outcome with numerical claim and exact supporting original abstract excerpt.
malformed_provider_fixture: Controlled malformed provider response, without changing the app source.
unsupported_gap_fixture: Controlled draft falsely claiming absence of evidence while snapshot contains relevant studies.
no_source_fixture: Persisted failed/empty-evidence answer outcome prepared by documented isolated fixture.
long_answer_fixture: Stored long answer/source content sufficient for multi-page PDF verification.
accepted_chinese_fixture: Genuinely accepted Chinese AI answer or clearly designated seeded layout-only fixture; seeded case cannot prove live Chinese synthesis.
punctuation_fixture: Publication metadata with citation punctuation needing BibTeX/Markdown escaping.
csv_fixture: Publication metadata containing commas, quotes and line breaks for CSV escape verification.
csv_formula_fixture: Controlled synthetic publication title with leading formula-like prefix.
no_external_effects: Only harmless inert test text; no active script, network exploit or patient data.
hosted_unconfigured: Public or isolated verified hosted instance in unconfigured model mode; do not change production configuration without permission.
hosted_restart: Operator-approved public/service restart while disposable synthetic data exists; no restart on a live service without permission.
hosted_second_browser: Two independent authenticated browser profiles/contexts, not merely a private tab on the same session.
